en: The front of the postcard shows an old photograph of a large, ornate, multi-story building set along a broad street lined with trees and parkland. The style of architecture is grand and classical, with decorative details on the facade and a tall spire on the building's corner. The text in the top left reads 'Sundsvall, Esplanaden.' The reverse side features multilingual indications for a postcard and handwritten messages in Swedish.
